outcome_selection_note: THIS RUN REPRODUCES A KNOWN SELECTION LEAK ON PURPOSE. A quote whose player recorded nothing was deleted rather than graded. The deleted set is enriched in comparisons the model LOSES, so every hit rate, gap and bucket below flatters the model by an unmeasured amount. It exists only to reproduce the superseded artifact.
absence_semantics_source: nfl.research.same_day_retrospective.ABSENCE_SEMANTICS -- imported, not copied, so the two scorers cannot drift apart about what an absent record means.
market_is_a_comparator_not_a_target: this repair governs WHICH comparisons are graded and nothing about what is compared. No price is a target, a label, a prior or a calibration anchor here, and no projection, draw or probability is altered by this module.

clean_overall.se_convention: A NAIVE BINOMIAL SE IS NOT EMITTED. Markets within a player-game, and player-games within a game, are not independent trials. clean_overall.player_game_clustering_note: several markets share a player-game in this stratum, so the player-game SE is a genuine second clustering.
